-- OrdTfSearch : one page of the order search (EV-ORD-102 / EV-ORD-104) SELECT o.OrderID, c.CompanyName AS CustomerName, e.LastName, e.FirstName, o.OrderDate, o.RequiredDate, o.ShippedDate, s.CompanyName AS ShipperName, ISNULL(d.Subtotal, 0) + ISNULL(o.Freight, 0) AS TotalAmount FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID LEFT JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID LEFT JOIN Shippers s ON s.ShipperID = o.ShipVia OUTER APPLY ( SELECT SUM(ROUND(CAST(od.UnitPrice AS decimal(19, 4)) * (1 - CAST(od.Discount AS decimal(5, 4))) * od.Quantity, 2)) AS Subtotal FROM [Order Details] od WHERE od.OrderID = o.OrderID ) d
WHERE AND o.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND o.EmployeeID = @EmployeeID AND o.OrderDate >= @OrderDateFrom AND CAST(o.OrderDate AS date) <= @OrderDateTo
AND o.ShippedDate IS NULL AND o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND o.RequiredDate IS NOT NULL AND ((o.ShippedDate IS NULL AND o.RequiredDate < @Today) OR (o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND o.ShippedDate > o.RequiredDate))
ORDER BY CAST(o.OrderDate AS date) DESC, o.OrderID DESC OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY
